title: Energy level diagram sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Seeded from science/y9 lesson 34 (Energy level diagram sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 34: Energy level diagrams and bonds. To understand how energy level diagrams show whether a reaction is exothermic or endothermic

picture.draw: Draw and label: Energy level diagram sheet

questions.q: Breaking 300 kJ, making 250 kJ. Type, and overall energy change?
questions.model: Compare: in 300, out 250. More taken in. 300 - 250 = 50 kJ taken in. Endothermic.

questions.q: On an exothermic diagram, are products higher or lower?

questions.a: The energy needed to start a reaction

questions.q: Draw labelled energy level diagrams for burning methane (exothermic) and photosynthesis (endothermic), with activation energy shown.
questions.a: Two diagrams with reactants, products, energy arrow and activation energy hump correctly placed
questions.model: Teacher draws the methane diagram on screen: axis, reactants line, hump, products lower, arrow down.

questions.q: Use bond energies: breaking 1370 kJ, making 1652 kJ. Find the overall change.
Why do wood fires not start on their own in a forest at 20 °C?
questions.a: The activation energy is not reached without a spark or very high heat.

questions.q: Big question: why must a match be struck?
questions.a: To provide the activation energy to start the reaction.
